summary: Riding season kept the store busy and the campaigns efficient. The account is still riding the gains from the location-targeting fix, with the optimization score holding at 91% and add-to-carts trending up week over week.
coverSub: How a tuned-up Google Ads account carried the ATV/UTV store through the heart of riding season on Shopify.
headline: The account's spring cleanup keeps paying off: optimization score held at 91% (up from 28% in March) and revenue tracked ahead of May. One open item: the enhanced conversions diagnostic still needs to clear for the cleanest possible data.
snapshotLead: Summer riding season met a healthy account. Add-to-carts climbed through the month and return on ad spend held above target.
takeaway: June proved the March fixes were structural, not lucky. Presence-only targeting and the rebuilt campaign settings are holding efficiency even as seasonal traffic scales the account up.

wins: Revenue and ROAS both grew in the same month, so the account scaled without buying junk traffic.
Optimization score held at 91%, the payoff from the March rebuild sticking through peak season.
Add-to-cart volume rose 11%, giving the funnel more retargeting fuel for July.
actions: Clear the enhanced conversions diagnostic and confirm MFA is enabled on the account login.
Break the top three product lines into their own asset groups for cleaner bidding.
Stand up a July retargeting layer against June's add-to-cart audience while it's still warm.
quote: From a 28% optimization score to 91% and holding. The account isn't recovering anymore, it's compounding.
